   198      uint8_t pad[2];          /* Align to 64 bits. */
   199      ovs_be32 port_no;
   200      ovs_be32 duration_sec;   /* Time port has been alive in seconds. */
   201      ovs_be32 duration_nsec;  /* Time port has been alive in nanoseconds beyond
   202                                  duration_sec. */
   203      ovs_be64 rx_packets;     /* Number of received packets. */
   204      ovs_be64 tx_packets;     /* Number of transmitted packets. */
   205      ovs_be64 rx_bytes;       /* Number of received bytes. */
   206      ovs_be64 tx_bytes;       /* Number of transmitted bytes. */
   207
   208      ovs_be64 rx_dropped;     /* Number of packets dropped by RX. */
   209      ovs_be64 tx_dropped;     /* Number of packets dropped by TX. */
   210      ovs_be64 rx_errors;      /* Number of receive errors.  This is a super-set
   211                                  of more specific receive errors and should be
   212                                  greater than or equal to the sum of all
   213                                  rx_*_err values in properties. */
   214      ovs_be64 tx_errors;      /* Number of transmit errors.  This is a super-set
   215                                  of more specific transmit errors and should be
   216                                  greater than or equal to the sum of all
   217                                  tx_*_err values (none currently defined.) */
   218      /* Followed by 0 or more OFPPSPT14_* properties. */
   219  };

   221

   223  /* ## ----------------- ## */
   224  /* ## ofp14_queue_stats ## */
   225  /* ## ----------------- ## */

   227  struct ofp14_queue_stats {
   228      ovs_be16 length;         /* Length of this entry. */
   229      uint8_t pad[6];          /* Align to 64 bits. */
   230      struct ofp13_queue_stats qs;
   231      /* Followed by 0 or more properties (none yet defined). */
   232  };

   142  struct ofp_header {

   155      ovs_be16 code;

   451      OFPFMF11_METADATA    = 1 << 15, /* Metadata passed between tables. */
   452  };

   454  /* Body of reply to OFPST_TABLE request. */
   455  struct ofp11_table_stats {

   457                                  are consulted first. */
   458      uint8_t pad[7];          /* Align to 64-bits. */
   459      char name[OFP_MAX_TABLE_NAME_LEN];
   460      ovs_be32 wildcards;      /* Bitmap of OFPFMF_* wildcards that are
   461                                  supported by the table. */
   462      ovs_be32 match;          /* Bitmap of OFPFMF_* that indicate the fields
   463                                  the table can match on. */
   464      ovs_be32 instructions;   /* Bitmap of OFPIT_* values supported. */
   465      ovs_be32 write_actions;  /* Bitmap of OFPAT_* that are supported
   466                                  by the table with OFPIT_WRITE_ACTIONS.  */
   467      ovs_be32 apply_actions;  /* Bitmap of OFPAT_* that are supported
   468                                  by the table with OFPIT_APPLY_ACTIONS. */
   469      ovs_be32 config;         /* Bitmap of OFPTC_* values */
   470      ovs_be32 max_entries;    /* Max number of entries supported. */
   471      ovs_be32 active_count;   /* Number of active entries. */
   472      ovs_be64 lookup_count;   /* Number of packets looked up in table. */
   473      ovs_be64 matched_count;  /* Number of packets that hit table. */
   474  };

   495      ovs_be64 tx_bytes;        /* Number of transmitted bytes. */
   496      ovs_be64 rx_dropped;      /* Number of packets dropped by RX. */
   497      ovs_be64 tx_dropped;      /* Number of packets dropped by TX. */

   506      ovs_be64 rx_crc_err;      /* Number of CRC errors. */
